observation.visible_scene: A coastal beach scene under a sunset/sunrise sky filled with orange, yellow and blue-grey clouds. A band of ocean with a breaking wave (white foam crest) sits at mid-frame, and a wide flat expanse of wet sand in the foreground mirrors the sky, showing warm golden-orange reflections on the left and cool teal-cyan reflections on the right. The horizon line is fixed across the view.
visible_changes: The white foam line of the breaking wave crests and rolls slowly toward the shore; its position and texture shift subtly from the first to the last frame, an ongoing wave motion rather than a start or stop.
The thin sheet of water on the wet sand advances and retreats slightly, reshaping and re-brightening the reflected orange and teal patches in the foreground.
The water surface between the foam bands ripples and changes texture continuously.
The cloud layout, sun glow and horizon remain essentially unchanged over the ~2.7 s excerpt (no visible cloud drift).
The framing is stable: the horizon and the left-edge cloud pattern hold the same vertical position throughout, indicating a static camera rather than a pan or zoom.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the wave completes its run onto the beach or pulls back after the excerpt ends.
The tide level, wind, or any larger wave set before or after this segment.
What lies beyond the left/right edges of the cropped frame.
uncertain_details: The wave's net translation toward shore is small; most visible change is internal deformation of the foam crest rather than a large positional shift.
Minor shifts in the sand reflections are consistent with moving water, but cannot be fully separated from subtle exposure changes.
No editing cut is apparent; all frames read as one continuous shot.
